violations.text: No person certified in food safety were present as needed at the time of inspection. New Violation. Correct By: 07/30/2026

Various items were observed in the hand-washing sink. PIC relocated items to designated area at time of inspection. A hand-washing sink must not be used for purposes other than hand washing. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 07/30/2026

Raw animal foods (whole shelled eggs) were observed stored above ready-to-eat foods (vegetables and cooked chicken) in the walk-in refrigerator. Employee moved eggs to lower shelf at time of inspection. Raw animal foods must be separated from raw ready-to-eat food such as vegetables during storage. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 07/30/2026

Macaroni salad and sour cream was observed held at (45-46) degrees Fahrenheit. Food was held in unit less than 4 hours. PIC moved food to walk-in cooler to rapidly cool at time of inspection. Time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food must be held at 41 degrees Fahrenheit or below except during preparation, cooking, or cooling. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 07/30/2026

Food contact surfaces of equipment/utensils ice machine were observed with an accumulation of food and debris. The food contact surfaces of equipment must be clean to sight and touch. Ice machine was turned off, and ice was disposed of at the time of inspection. Establishment is not to use ice machine until it is properly cleaned and sanitized. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 05/19/2026

Wood is used in the construction of behind the bar 3-bay sink, and the base of walk-in cooler door. Non-food contact surfaces of equipment that are exposed to splash, spillage, or other food soiling or that require frequent cleaning must be constructed of a nonabsorbent and smooth material. New Violation. Correct By: 05/26/2026
Establishment is currently lacking a dumpster. Per PIC, dumpster has been ordered. Establishment is to send proof of dumpster to inspector. New Violation. Correct By: 05/19/2026

The floor under the 3-bay sink/ grease trap area has an accumulation of soil residue and food debris. The physical facilities shall be cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. New Violation. Correct By: 05/19/2026

The floor and wall junctures in the dry storage and partially under the 3-bay sink do not have coving. The floor and wall junctures must be coved and closed to no larger than 1/32nd of an inch. New Violation. Correct By: 05/26/2026
